files.purpose: Upstream Odoo LGPL-3.0-only license text preserved verbatim; LGPLv3 + GPLv3 full text. License boundary authority for the absorption.
account.account model: the chart of accounts (科目表) that every journal entry line references via account_id. Needed to model double-entry accounting.
account.move model: invoices and journal entries (凭证). Contains the balanced-journal-entry state machine and invoice_ids linkage used by sale.order.
account.move.line model: the debit/credit lines (account_id/debit/credit/partner_id) composing a balanced journal entry. Core of double-entry modeling.
uom.uom rounding precision onchange guard (decimal precision warning). Shows how UOM rounding precision is validated against decimal accuracy.

SaleOrder model: state machine is draft/sent/sale/cancel (SALE_ORDER_STATE; there is no 'done' state). Delivered/invoiced/paid are NOT sale.order states: delivery quantity is tracked separately (see sale_stock line + stock moves) and payment state belongs to account.move / payment allocation.

SaleOrderLine model: per-line product_id/quantity/price, plus progress fields qty_delivered and qty_invoiced. These are orthogonal progress fields, NOT drivers of the commercial state machine: they are computed separately from stock moves / invoice lines and tracked via the independent invoice_status field. sale.order.state itself remains draft/sent/sale/cancel.
sale_stock bridge: turns sale order lines into stock moves/procurements for delivery, tracking qty_delivered for order fulfillment. Stock fulfillment of sale orders.

stock.warehouse.orderpoint (Minimum Inventory Rule): the min/max source. product_min_qty / product_max_qty define the reordering bounds and qty_to_order / qty_to_order_computed compute the quantity to order against virtual stock. Inventory reordering min/max study.

stock.replenish.mixin: only exposes route_id and computes allowed_route_ids (allowed routes for replenishment) via _compute_allowed_route_ids / _get_allowed_route_domain. It does NOT calculate min/max or qty-to-order (that lives in stock_orderpoint.py). Replenishment route selection study.
stock.rule model: procurement/delivery rules (buy/make/outsource) that route stock moves and drive replenishment. Fulfillment + reordering routing logic.
Base uom.uom and uom.category models: unit-of-measure categories and conversion rates (factor/inverse rounding). Primary multi-unit conversion study file.

res.partner model: child partner addresses via child_ids (res.partner with parent_id) whose type selection includes ('invoice','Invoice Address') and ('delivery','Delivery Address'), resolved through address_get(adr_pref). There are NO invoice_address_id / delivery_address_id fields. Partner multi-address study file.
